data.case_title: Basement moisture survey – reply to surveyor's quote
data.summary: Musterhausen Bausachverständige GbR, a building surveyor firm, wrote on 20 November 2026 about the requested assessment of moisture in the basement (Feuchtigkeit im Keller) and enclosed a flat-rate offer. They ask for a reply within 15 working days of the letter date on whether the report should be commissioned.
data.explanation: This is a quote (Angebot) from a building surveyor for assessing the cause of dampness in your basement. You need to decide whether to commission the report and reply by the deadline shown. If you do not reply in time, the offer may lapse and the firm may not proceed. This is a business decision, not a legal obligation, so take your time to compare offers if needed, but reply before the stated period runs out.
